heroHeadline: Ukraine Strikes Kerch Bridge; Russia Hits Odesa and Energy Grid in Overnight Barrage
heroSubtitle: A Ukrainian attack on Nov 17 collapsed part of the Kerch Bridge. Russia answered with 141 drones overnight, killing at least five people nationwide, four of them in Odesa, and cutting power to 80+ settlements in Rivne oblast.
